source_summary: Monochrome ink Chinese landscape with towering cliffs, misty valleys, a left-side temple village with pagoda and pavilions, dense pine and shrub brushwork, foreground rocks, paths, tiny travelers, and winter trees. Calligraphy, seals, border, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_twin_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall pale cliff formation on the left with two rounded summit masses and dark vertical creases, stopping above the village roofs and foreground trees.
must_preserve: soft gray wash around the cliff silhouette
dark broken contour lines along both cliff edges

motifs.name: temple_village_pagoda_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the clustered architecture below the left cliff: pagoda tower, layered pavilion roofs, small adjoining buildings, and surrounding dark evergreens.

motifs.name: left_foreground_rocks_path_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground slope with winding pale path, rounded boulders, low shrubs, and dark clustered brush at the base of the village hill.
must_preserve: dense black foliage dots near the slope

motifs.name: central_slender_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow central upright rock spire rising from the misty valley, including its irregular outline and faint base rocks but excluding the left village and right massif.
must_preserve: soft mist fading around the base
small broken rock marks near lower edge

motifs.name: right_high_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant right-side mountain mass with high rounded cliffs, dark central ravines, and scrubby tree crowns along the top ridge.

motifs.name: right_foreground_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the low sweeping pine in the right foreground, including its leaning trunks and long horizontal needled branches.
must_preserve: dry black ink accents at branch tips

motifs.name: winter_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground grove of mostly leafless winter trees and brush across the lower right-center, excluding the large mountain behind as much as possible.

motifs.name: lower_bridge_travelers_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower center passage with small bridge or plank structure, rocks, path edge, and tiny traveler-like figures nearby.
must_preserve: short parallel bridge or plank lines
small clustered dots and broken brush along the ground

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
